title: One Invite button lets a Tailscale login into every install on the machine, with no sign-in link
description: Two real installs on one simulated Tailscale machine, each with its own Postgres, TCP port and serve socket; only the tailscale command and the Tailscale API are stubbed. The operator's human session opens Invite from the top bar of the first install, saves a Tailscale API token from the one inline line, and invites ana@example.com as Viewer to both installs: one message carries the Tailscale invite and both install addresses and no Graphyard sign-in link, and Copy copies it. A request on either install's serve socket carrying Tailscale-User-Login ana@example.com reaches Work as ana with no sign-in step and her visit is in the history; bob@example.com is told to ask the owner; the same header on the 127.0.0.1 TCP port gets no session; the dialog still lists ana after reload; revoking her there refuses her next socket request on both installs; a reader, a maintainer and an operator-agent identity get 403 from POST /api/invites; and inviting two logins at once makes one multiUse device invite.

steps.name: Invite from the top bar to both installs and reach them through the serve socket
